title: Illustrative UK original clothing label economics
status: research scenario, not a sales forecast, supplier commitment or permission to spend
jurisdiction_assumption: UK-established seller fulfilling from UK to UK adult clothing customers; user's location and legal status unconfirmed
base_vat_basis: Seller not VAT registered. VAT-inclusive supplier cash costs retained; no output VAT deducted from customer receipts.

assumptions.return_assumptions: Full product and standard-delivery refund; zero returned-stock recovery; zero supplier reimbursement assumed; original card fee retained; customer-paid non-fault return postage assumed and must be reflected in disclosed terms.
assumptions.labour_value_status: Opportunity-cost assumption, not a claim about statutory or market pay
assumptions.store_allowance_note: GBP25 published monthly price plus GBP5 tax headroom. Not a verified tax-inclusive invoice. Three months budgeted; promotion excluded.
assumptions.batch_ceilings_status: Proposed maximum quote targets including one decoration and agreed branding. Not verified quotations; cannot infer same quality or savings.
assumptions.art_cash_note: Founder-made original artwork only; commissioned artwork must receive a separate quote.

conditions: Accepted written quote and supplier minimum compatible with ordered sizes
Published closing date, threshold and agreed delivery date
Refund plan if threshold not met
Keep receipts available pending manufacturing decision
Ring-fence fulfilment costs and reserves after committing

break_even_notes.fixed_cash_basis: POD samples GBP120 + shop3months GBP90 + domain GBP15 +3 gifted tees GBP72.24 =GBP297.24. Excludes reusable float and unspent contingency.
break_even_notes.fixed_founder_hours: 60 setup hours +4 hours/week for12weeks =108hours. Extra10min per order is deducted from contribution.
break_even_notes.unit_basis: Separate all-tee and all-hoodie cases, not a sales mix or sales forecast
break_even_notes.formula: ceil((fixed_cash + fixed_founder_hours * hourly_value) / (contribution - CAC - variable_minutes * hourly_value / 60))
break_even_notes.zero_or_negative_denominator: No finite break-even under those assumptions
break_even_notes.profit_tax_note: Thresholds before profit taxes; actual additional overhead and time increase them.
